description: A pair of meters showing the level of two signals passing through, each lamp a 3dB step

inputs.text: The left signal the meter shows; it reaches the left output unchanged
The right signal the meter shows; it reaches the right output unchanged

outputs.text: The left signal from the input, unchanged
The right signal from the input, unchanged

notes: The top of the scale is 10V, so a signal peaking well below that lights only the lowest lamps.
